text.card: A red giant 3,166 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.00 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,137 K at its surface.
